Some possible steps to entering St. Petersburg
- Jutland and Baltic research done for World Map (you must have North Seas done as the basic requirement to do other World Map researches).

- Bring some QMPs into Stockholm. Take the quest from the Merchant mediator regarding 17th Century Pt. 3 quest which requires you to talk to market keepers of Stockholm, Oslo, Bergen and London. Submit the quest in London via Barmaid.

- Equip the Adept of the Age 17th Century Pt 3 on and go to Stockholm with QMPs and try to spawn the quests (you should not be burning more than 5 qmps otherwise something is wrong somewhere).

- Additional skills I picked up according to player rumours is the Sociability skill which I dumped long time ago from London merchant guild which doing the merchant quest.

This is not a 100% accurate guide and needs more correction and proofing for consistency.

comments.author: Guilder
comments.body:
The steps I took are as follows:

1. Accept World Map quest from Mercator
2. Complete the mandatory North Sea chart, report to Mercator
3. Select and complete the Baltic Sea chart
4. Enter Stockholm (Square) and talk with the Merchant Mediator. Look for a blue 5-star Chrono Quest called "Delivery Request to the capital of Russia" (Arctic language listed as required, but body language will get you through the quest just fine)

Completion of the quest yields the 18th Century Part 3 chrono title (equip it after reporting the quest, and you can see all the special recipes, items, and trade goods St. Petersburg has to offer). The JP info site GVDB doesn't list any other requirements beyond that, but here's a link if you're looking for a walkthrough:

gvdb.mydns.jp/db/module/QuestDB/action/QuestShow?id=3610

Two more points: the quest is a storyline event based one, so I don't believe it's repeatable. There are other Chrono Quests related to Russia after that, so you can regain the title if you ever lose it, but if you pull this particular quest, you might want to try and share it with friends/company members/folks looking for the quest.

Also, there is a barmaid in St. Petersburg, but there are no barmaid gift items in the Item Shop unless you have the Chrono title equipped -- be sure to bring something if you don't want to return to Stockholm right away to report the finished quest.

comments.author: Snipe
comments.body:
Hi, just wanted to share a few pointers about the northern passage and a little glitch :) Most of you know that your ship would constantly lose dura from ice floes, but bear in mind that the damage is 10-20 in some seas and up to 50+ or about 100 in other seas, so keep your wood even if your default daily repairing is more than the damaged caused :), also all the fleets ive seen there are first class vaiss, so it is a good place to grind if you dont mind the lack of ports :) there are new discoveries here like the iceberg from a quest in Amsterdam and new species of fish (although none in memorial album ive seen) :)

Now, the most important part of the message: if you look at an external uwo map of the northern passage, you will find three supply ports scattered quite evenly across the northern passage. if you dock at ANY of these ports and click the aide tow button, there will be a list of Europe cities to tow to, including seville which takes only 6 minutes! This is EXTREMELY useful to those charting the northern passage, as it eliminates the need to waste an hour sailing back to Amsterdam. This is obviously a glitch, which i think would be patched in the next few weeks. Until then, please make full use of this glitch and i hope this "cheat" is useful to you :D
